title: A semester with no lost assignments
description: Assignments are linked to courses and to the class schedule. You can see the nearest due dates and the weeks that carry a lot of work.

blocks.text: At the start of the semester the classes and some of the due dates are known, but after that assignments come in across different courses. A single list does not always show which week will become overloaded.

quote.text: I have used MSL for the past 5 years and loved it. I mainly used the task function to track class assignments. It was super easy to add all my classes for the semester and enter in the due dates of all my assignments at the beginning of the year. I could go to tasks

blocks.text: Link an assignment to a course, a hand-in date and the schedule. Show the week’s assignments together while keeping the ability to change the due date of a single one. The suggested date of the next class is confirmed by the person; it must not automatically become the due date for every piece of work.
Ask a student to enter assignments from their own materials and to move one class. Check whether the real due dates are visible and whether a second calendar is needed for the same information.
